Las autoridades envían unos 200.000 mensajes de alerta para pedir evacuaciones ante el riesgo de nuevas crecidas. La emergencia llega cuando Nepal todavía se recupera de las devastadoras inundaciones de agosto, que dejaron más de 1.400 muertos y miles de desaparecidos cerca de la frontera con China. Pada Minggu, 11 Oktober 2026, banjir bandang menerjang kawasan Sungai Budhi Gandaki di Distrik Gorkha, Nepal. Air bah membawa lumpur dan menghantam permukiman serta infrastruktur di sejumlah desa. Longsor diduga menyumbat aliran sungai atau anak sungai, kemudian memicu luapan air secara mendadak. Laporan The Kathmandu Post memperkirakan sekitar 35–40 rumah hanyut dan beberapa jembatan rusak atau hancur. Lokasi pembangunan proyek pembangkit listrik tenaga air juga terdampak. Lima orang dilaporkan hilang dalam laporan Reuters, sementara 49 orang berhasil diselamatkan oleh tim militer Nepal. Data korban masih dapat berubah seiring proses pencarian. Sebelumnya pada Rabu, 26 Agustus 2026, banjir bandang dahsyat menerjang Distrik Rasuwa, Nepal, dan berdampak pada sejumlah wilayah di sepanjang aliran Sungai Bhote Koshi dan Trishuli. Laporan awal Radio Nepal pada 26 Agustus mencatat 95 korban meninggal yang telah ditemukan atau terkonfirmasi saat itu. Angka tersebut merupakan data pada tahap awal penanganan bencana. Uma forte enchente no rio Budhi Gandaki atingiu o distrito de Gorkha, no Nepal, neste domingo (11), destruindo casas, pontes e trilhas. Mais de 100 turistas estrangeiros ficaram isolados em diferentes pontos da região, localizada a cerca de 100 quilômetros de Katmandu. Segundo as autoridades nepalesas, um deslizamento de terra bloqueou o rio na região de Chumnubri, provocando inundações rio abaixo. A correnteza, carregada de lama e detritos, atingiu comunidades e danificou instalações de projetos hidrelétricos. Até esta segunda-feira (12), 96 pessoas haviam sido resgatadas, incluindo nove estrangeiros. Cinco moradores continuavam desaparecidos, e não havia registro de mortes confirmadas. As equipes seguem trabalhando para alcançar as áreas isoladas. 🎥 Reprodução: Clip Lions | @myhoodbr 📺 Confira na JP News 📌 Siga o nosso perfil @jovempannews #Nepal #Enchente #DesastreNatural #Resgate #Ásia

Nepal has been struck by another major flash flood, this time along the banks of the Budhi Gandaki River in the Gorkha region. The flood wiped out entire neighbourhoods, bridges and damaged a hydropower station. At least five people remain missing. The country is on high alert after a catastrophic flood in August that killed more than 1,400 people, followed by another flood and landslides last month. Nepal is a largely rural nation of 30 million people that has contributed little to the greenhouse gas emissions driving global warming. Its prime minister Balendra Shah says reconstruction could cost billions of dollars. The nation's economy is already under pressure, with limited resources to respond to multiple disasters. Authorities say scores of people in the region left their homes ahead of the Gorkha flash flood, with many now left wondering where they will live.
